holding_summary: Commercial lease dispute over a skating rink's use of a hall (eviction defense and improvements/fixture reconvention); affirms rent judgment, amends award for a removable iron railing.
notes: Commercial building lease/eviction and fixtures dispute between a corporation and a skating rink company; no dwelling, lodging, or boarding-house issue.

holding_summary: Suit on promissory notes; exception to venue overruled on finding of defendant's domicile despite alternating residence between two towns.
notes: Personal domicile determination for venue purposes (defendant lived at property 'as an invited guest'); no compensated occupancy or lodging arrangement at issue.

holding_summary: Mandamus proceeding over third-possessor improvements (an irrigation canal) made under an agreement to rent land at a fair rental value; company held not a good-faith possessor entitled to reimbursement from the mortgagee.
notes: Agricultural land rental/improvements and mortgage foreclosure priority dispute; no dwelling or lodging arrangement.

holding_summary: Tax situs dispute over a foreign insurance company's Louisiana loan notes; statute taxing such credits held constitutional.
notes: Corporate taxation of credits/notes; no relation to dwellings, lodging, or boarding.

holding_summary: Insanity commitment proceeding reversed because the statute applies only to state residents/citizens, and defendant's brief stay in the parish was temporary.
notes: Residency determination for interdiction/commitment jurisdiction; no compensated occupancy or lodging issue.

holding_summary: Specific performance suit compelling an adjudicatee to accept title from a succession partition sale; family meeting and prescription/absentee-heir defenses rejected.
notes: Succession partition and title dispute; no dwelling occupancy, lodging, or boarding issue.

holding_summary: Conviction for maintaining a 'blind tiger' liquor nuisance reversed; the police-jury ordinance was superseded by a later, ex post facto statute.
notes: Liquor-nuisance ('blind tiger') criminal prosecution under a police-jury ordinance; not a lodging/boarding-house regulation.

holding_summary: Possessory action over an oil-and-gas lease; contract with delay-rental and cancellation clauses held not void, so lessee's possession under it defeats owner's possessory claim.
notes: Mineral/oil-and-gas lease validity and possessory-action pleading rules; unrelated to dwelling occupancy or lodging.

holding_summary: Separation from bed and board granted on grounds of excesses and cruel treatment, with defamation (spreading rumors of wife's insanity) as contributing evidence.
notes: Marital separation ('bed and board') case; unrelated to letting of rooms/dwellings despite phrase overlap with the corpus's search terms.

holding_summary: Conviction for keeping a 'blind tiger' reversed; police jury lacked authority to enact the liquor-keeping ordinance absent a voter-approved regulation.
notes: Liquor-nuisance prosecution and police jury's regulatory authority; not a lodging/boarding-house case.

holding_summary: Party-wall reimbursement dispute between adjoining Canal Street property owners; defendant owes half the reconstruction cost.
notes: Party-wall construction cost dispute; no occupancy, lodging, or letting issue.

holding_summary: State board of health held to have jurisdiction, concurrent with New Orleans's local board, to enjoin an unsanitary bakery as a public-health nuisance.
notes: Police-power/public-health regulation case, but the regulated business is a bakery, not a lodging or boarding house; outside corpus scope.

holding_summary: Continuation of a family partition/accounting suit; rents and disbursements between mother and daughter co-owners recast per prior appellate ruling.
notes: Accounting for rents among family co-owners of inherited property; not a compensated lodging/letting arrangement.

holding_summary: Railroad enjoined from letting its depot-ground warehouse be used for a lessee's private business, as the deed restricted use to railroad purposes.
notes: Deed-restriction dispute over railroad warehouse/depot grounds leased for grain storage; not dwelling occupancy or lodging.

holding_summary: Heirs' suit to recover community-property land rejected on grounds of prior settlement, dation en paiement, and 10/30-year prescription.
notes: Community-property title and prescription dispute; no occupancy, lodging, or letting issue.

holding_summary: Assault-and-battery damages suit against a town marshal who beat a baker with a pistol while quelling a disturbance among the baker's after-hours guests; damages increased against the marshal.
notes: Baker entertaining friends at his shop, and their sobriety/noise under municipal ordinances, is not compensated lodging; case is a false-arrest/assault tort, not a letting arrangement.

holding_summary: Retail-liquor license claims against an interstate brewer; 1898 general license law inapplicable to interstate commerce, but the 1908 Gay-Shattuck Act's police-power license upheld.
notes: Liquor licensing and interstate commerce/Wilson Act analysis; unrelated to dwelling lodging or boarding houses.

holding_summary: Certified questions on procedure for landlord eviction suits under Act 313 of 1908: appeal delay runs from oral rendition of judgment, judgments must be signed in open court, and eviction becomes executory 24 hours after rendition absent a suspensive appeal.
notes: General landlord-tenant summary eviction procedure applicable to any house/store/land lease; no facts about a householder letting rooms or a lodging/boarding arrangement, so it addresses the ordinary landlord-tenant regime rather than the corpus's specific practice.
